title: Feeding a working camp
scene: A practical riverside military camp kitchen: adults cooking rice in soot-blackened clay pots over two low earthen hearths, baskets of supplies and firewood, a few resting boatmen nearby, oars stacked under a separate thatch shelter. Humid early morning, no battle, luxury tent, royal feast or modern mess tins.
